facts.text: John joined a service-focused online group last week, which has been an emotional experience for him.

evidence.quote: I joined a service-focused online group last week and it's been an emotional ride.

facts.text: John described the members of the online group as incredible and noted that they share inspiring stories.

evidence.quote: Everyone there is incredible with their own inspiring stories.

facts.text: John mentioned that the online group has helped him feel a sense of connection and purpose.

evidence.quote: I'm feeling a sense of connection and purpose with them.

facts.text: John and others from the online group organized a toy drive for kids in need and visited a homeless shelter to give out food and supplies.

evidence.quote: We held some events and got to meet some people. We went to a homeless shelter to give out food and supplies.
We also organized a toy drive for kids in need.
